/auto.heading: Car Diffusers — Waterless, No Subscription, Your Oil
/auto.intro: Every Autivara car diffuser is waterless — no tank, no spills, no subscription. Drop in a few drops of any oil you already own, clip it to your vent (or charge it and set it anywhere), and drive in your signature scent. Seven models from $16–$39, all refillable indefinitely.

chooser.title: Vent-Clip Figures ($19) — Best for Character & Simplicity
chooser.body: Astronaut, Bear, Guitar, and Pear figures clip onto any air vent. Waterless felt/oil core, refillable in seconds. The most affordable entry point — and genuinely display-worthy on your dash.

chooser.title: Machined Metal Disc ($34) — Best for a Minimal, Grown-Up Look
chooser.body: Solid machined metal with a magnetic snap top. No novelty shape — just a sleek two-piece disc that clips to your vent and arrives gift-boxed. Waterless refillable felt pad.

chooser.title: Pulse Smart Spray ($39) — Best for Hands-Free Timed Scenting
chooser.body: The only model that sprays on its own. Set a mist timer, choose one of three intensity levels, and let it run. Ambient light ring for night drives. USB-C rechargeable.

chooser.title: Rechargeable Waterless Diffuser ($39) — Best Vent-Free Placement
chooser.body: USB-C rechargeable and vent-independent — sits upright anywhere in the cabin without clipping to an air vent. Adjustable output, no water tank, no spills.

chooser.title: Aviator Bear Spinning Propeller ($19) — Best for a Bit of Motion
chooser.body: The propeller actually spins on your vent's airflow, fanning scent evenly through the cabin. Soft-touch silicone clip, magnetic top for mess-free refills, waterless core.

chooser.title: Guitar Swaying Figure ($19) — Best for Music Lovers
chooser.body: Sways gently with airflow on a 360° rotating silicone clip. Waterless refillable scent core, works on any air vent. A quiet, movement-based detail for the dash.

faqs.question: Do I need a subscription for a car diffuser?
faqs.answer: Not with Autivara. Every model is a one-time purchase — you fill it with any essential or fragrance oil you already own, and refill it whenever you like. There is no subscription, no proprietary vial system, and no recurring charge required to keep using it.

faqs.question: Which Autivara car diffuser lasts longest?
faqs.answer: All Autivara car diffusers are refillable indefinitely, so the diffuser itself doesn't expire. Scent longevity between refills depends on the oil you use and the output setting you choose. The Rechargeable Car Diffuser ($39) and the Pulse Smart Spray ($39) both have adjustable output modes that let you stretch each fill further by starting at the lowest setting and increasing only as needed.

faqs.question: What's the difference between a waterless car diffuser and a regular car air freshener?
faqs.answer: A traditional disposable air freshener (hanging card, gel vent clip, or plastic unit) has a fixed fragrance baked in — once it fades in 2–4 weeks, you throw it away and buy another. A waterless car diffuser like Autivara's uses a dry felt pad or scent core that you recharge with a few drops of any oil. You choose the scent, control the intensity, and reuse the same unit indefinitely — no single-use plastic waste, no locked-in fragrance, no subscription.

/industrial.heading: Commercial Scent Diffusers — Own Your Oil, No Contract Required
/industrial.intro: Autivara's commercial scenting line covers every venue size — from a boutique fitting room to a 2,000+ sq ft hotel lobby — with waterless, app-scheduled diffusers you buy once and run on any oil you choose. Unlike ScentAir and Aroma360, there is no proprietary refill contract, no locked fragrance subscription, and no monthly service fee. Choose your unit, choose your oil, and control the schedule from an app.

rows: Plug into any wall outlet — no mounting

chooser.title: Small office, boutique, or guest suite
chooser.body: The Smart Plug-In ($79) slots into any wall outlet and covers up to ~500 sq ft. No mounting hardware, no wiring — scenting in minutes. Ideal for dental waiting rooms, hair salons, small retail, and hotel guest rooms.

chooser.title: Medium lobby, showroom, or spa
chooser.body: The Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) wall-mounts without plumbing and covers up to ~1,000 sq ft. Schedule fragrance intensity by the hour from the app. A strong fit for restaurant entrances, med-spas, and mid-size retail floors.

chooser.title: Whole venue — hotel, large restaurant, or event space
chooser.body: The Atmos Pro HVAC ($349) ties into your existing ductwork and scents 2,000+ sq ft evenly through the vents you already have. One unit, one app, entire building — the top of the Autivara commercial range.

faqs.question: Do commercial scent diffusers require a contract?
faqs.answer: Autivara commercial diffusers require no contract. You purchase the unit outright and use any compatible fragrance oil you choose — there is no mandatory subscription, no proprietary refill cartridge, and no monthly service fee. This differs from some commercial scenting services that lock customers into long-term fragrance supply agreements.

faqs.question: How much does commercial scenting cost per month?
faqs.answer: With Autivara, your ongoing cost is the price of the fragrance oil you use — there is no monthly platform fee or service contract. Your only upfront cost is the diffuser itself: $79 for the Smart Plug-In, $149 for the Atmos Wi-Fi, or $349 for the Atmos Pro HVAC. Oil consumption varies by unit, space size, and the intensity level you schedule in the app.

faqs.question: What is the coverage area of an HVAC scent diffuser?
faqs.answer: The Atmos Pro HVAC is designed to cover 2,000+ sq ft by connecting to your building's existing ductwork and distributing fragrance evenly through the vents already in place. Actual coverage depends on your HVAC system layout, airflow rate, ceiling height, and the intensity setting you configure in the app.

faqs.question: Which diffuser is right for a restaurant?
faqs.answer: For a restaurant entrance or bar area up to ~1,000 sq ft, the Atmos Wi-Fi ($149) wall-mounted unit lets you schedule scent on and off around service times from an app. For a full dining room or multi-room venue over 2,000 sq ft, the Atmos Pro HVAC ($349) delivers even coverage through your existing ductwork.

faqs.question: Can I use my own fragrance oils in a commercial diffuser?
faqs.answer: Yes. All three Autivara commercial diffusers — the Smart Plug-In, Atmos Wi-Fi, and Atmos Pro HVAC — use a waterless nebulizing system compatible with the fragrance oil of your choice. There are no locked proprietary cartridges.

faqs.question: What commercial verticals are these diffusers suited for?
faqs.answer: The Autivara commercial line is used across restaurants (entrance and dining scenting), salons and spas (ambient wellness fragrance), dental and medical offices (odor neutralization and calming scent), and retail environments (signature scent branding). Choose the unit whose coverage area matches your space.
